summary.problem: When a SessionStart hook emits a systemMessage, it renders twice at session start — once with a command source annotation tag and once without.
summary.root_cause: AppContainer directly rendered result.systemMessage via historyManager.addItem upon completing fireSessionStartEvent while also receiving the same message via the HookSystemMessage event-bus listener. Furthermore, hookEventHandler.ts restricted HookSystemMessage emissions to outputFormat === 'json', requiring the event-bus check to be expanded so plain-text hooks are not lost when direct rendering is removed.
summary.context: BeforeAgent and BeforeTool hooks rendered system messages only once because they exclusively relied on the event-bus path. Plain-text hooks convert stdout into systemMessage via convertPlainTextToHookOutput, so removing direct rendering in AppContainer requires hookEventHandler.ts to emit HookSystemMessage for text-format hooks as well.

steps: In packages/cli/src/ui/AppContainer.tsx, remove the direct historyManager.addItem invocation for result.systemMessage in the session start useEffect, and remove the associated react-hooks/exhaustive-deps eslint-disable comment.

In packages/core/src/hooks/hookEventHandler.ts, update the system message emission check from if (result.output?.systemMessage && result.outputFormat === 'json') to if (result.output?.systemMessage) so coreEvents.emitHookSystemMessage is emitted for both 'json' and 'text' output formats.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: SessionStart hooks emit systemMessage events strictly through the event bus for both JSON and text formats, resulting in a single rendered banner in the UI.
verification_steps: Run Vitest suite on AppContainer tests: npx vitest run packages/cli/src/ui/AppContainer.test.tsx
Run Vitest suite on hookEventHandler tests: npx vitest run packages/core/src/hooks/hookEventHandler.test.ts
Assert in AppContainer.test.tsx that session start does not trigger direct historyManager.addItem calls lacking a source tag.
Assert in hookEventHandler.test.ts that emitHookSystemMessage is called for both json and text output formats when systemMessage is present.
